wb.name: World Bank, World Development Indicators
wb.note: Price level = PPP conversion factor for private consumption / market exchange rate (US = 1). Homicides per 100k (UNODC), political stability (Worldwide Governance Indicators, -2.5..2.5), electricity access %.

eurostat.name: Eurostat (price level indices EU27 = 100, house price index, city statistics)

bea.name: US Bureau of Economic Analysis, Regional Price Parities (US = 100)

hud.name: US HUD Fair Market Rents FY2027
hud.note: 40th-percentile gross rent (rent + utilities) for a standard unit, by county.

zillow.name: Zillow Research: home value index (ZHVI, typical home) and observed rent index (ZORI, typical asking rent)
zillow.note: Typical home value = middle third of homes. Typical rent = asking rents on new listings.

perdiem.name: US State Department foreign per diem rates (hotel ceiling + meals & incidentals, USD/day)

allowances.name: US State Department post allowances (cost-of-living %, hardship %, danger pay %)
allowances.note: Cost-of-living % is how much more than Washington, DC a US employee is paid there to keep the same living standard (0 = not more expensive). Hardship and danger pay are the government's own ratings of living conditions and violence.

fx.name: Exchange rates (open.er-api.com, from central bank and market data)

eia.name: US EIA weekly retail gasoline and diesel prices

euoil.name: EU Weekly Oil Bulletin (pump prices with taxes)
